Independent exact bounded enumeration: iterate product(range(n), repeat=n) for n=1–6, make mask with bit j set when occurrence count of j is one, and sum (-1)^popcount(mask & ((1<<k)-1)) for k=0,...,n. Target-label symmetry makes those representatives exhaustive by weight. n=4 gave (256,40,16,-8,160); n=6 gave (46656,9156,2376,396,336,-684,17496); n=2 gave (4,0,4). The classifications matched throughout.
correctness.rationale: A weight-k character assigns the product of 1-2 times each selected singleton indicator, i.e. factors 1−2·indicator. For a prescribed j-subset of selected targets to be singleton, choose their distinct labelled preimages in (n)_j ways and then map all remaining inputs into the other n-j targets. This gives the full multiplier formula with 0^0=1, and the equivalent exponential series is obtained by replacing e^z by e^z-2z in k factors. For odd n the j=0 term is odd and all other terms even. For even n>=4, k>0, set a=v2(n), b=v2(k); j=1 has valuation 1+a+b since n-1 is odd. For j=0, na>1+a+b (including n=4), using b<=floor(log2 n). Factoring kn/j from the coefficient for j>=2 supplies valuation at least a+b+j-v2(j), before the (n-j)^(n-j) factor. For j>=3 the excess j-v2(j) is at least two, including j=n with the endpoint convention; j=2 receives at least two more powers of two from the positive even n-2. Thus j=1 has unique least valuation. The weight-zero output is n^n. For n=2 the two constant maps give the empty mask and the two bijections give the full mask, so the eigenvalues by weight are 4,0,4 and the nullity is two. At n=1 the unique mask is full, giving 1,-1. The binomial count of weight-k characters gives the stated determinant and dyadic multiplicities.

value.rationale: Singleton incidence is a natural dependent occupancy statistic for labelled finite mappings. Determining recoverability for every dimension, including the two lost modes at the exceptional dimension, and the exact arithmetic strata of all nonconstant modes is a structural classification. The nearby vacant-image problem has genuinely different dyadic arithmetic, so the refinement is not a renaming. The determinant formula is a direct useful corollary rather than the sole contribution.
residual_risks: The dyadic strata do not give the real condition number, signs, or a recovery algorithm with additional performance guarantees.
